Name: Game Achievements Thank you letters
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
You will receive thank you letters from NPC's as you complete Game Achievements. Most letters will arrive a day or two after you complete the achievement. Most letters will come with a small gift.  MAKE SURE TO CHOOSE TAXES OR NO TAXES BEFORE YOU HIT EARN GOLD ACHIEVMENT. TAXES WILL TAKE GOLD AWAY. DEFAULT IS TAXES.  If you change from no taxes to taxes you will get letters for the any gold achievements completed before you switched.


1. Community Upgrades (Pam's House, Town Short Cuts)
2. Community Center (Bridge Repair/Quarry, Bus working, Minecarts working, Restored Greenhouse, Glowing Boulder removed, Community Center completed) 
3. Movie Theater 
4. Mining (Opened up Skull Cavern})
5. Ginger Island (Willy boat is fixed, Rescued Professor Snail, Resort repaired) 
6. Travel (Been to Secret Woods, Has Town Key, Purchased Return Scepter)
7. Friendship Level 10 (Dwarf, Jas, Krobus, Leo, Vincent, Willy)
8. Skill Level 10 (Combat, Farming, Fishing, Foraging, Mining)
9. Farmhouse upgrades (kitchen, nursey)
10. Festivals (Egg Hunt, Ice Fishing, SDV Fair). 
11. Power (Read all books)
12. Blank
13. Earn Gold (15K, 50K, 250K, 1M, 10M) Choice between taxes or not. Taxes take money for the community. 
14. Blank
15. Cooking (10, 40, all)
16. Crafting (15, 30, all)
17. Help Wanted Requests (10, 40)
18. Catch fish (10 different, 24 different, catch all, catch 100 total)
19. Ship items (15 of each crop, 300 of one crop, all)
20. Blank
21. More Friendship (New friends, Best friends, Beloved farmer, Cliques, Networking, Popular)
